    The class Library contains a book library, album library, and series library, along with respective methods for adding, removing, displaying, and summarizing entries/libraries,
    MediaEntry
    The class MediaEntry serves as the abstract class for the classes Book, Album, and Series
    It contains a constructor to define and initialize an entry's information as attributes, and accompanying methods and getters for adding, manipulating, and returning such attributes
    Series
    The class Series contains the attributes, constructor, methods, and getters necessary for the creation, modification, and manipulation of a series entry with:
    the inherited methods of: assigning a status (and modifying it), assigning a rating, and assigning a review; and
    the unique methods of: assigning the number of episodes per season, updating the series entry's current episode and season progress, and returning its information via String
